note: Now Lamar Sportsman RV Park and Horse Motel (5385 US-50, 3 mi west of Lamar on the north side). General transient RV park that also offers horse stalls -- not equestrian-only; takes motorhomes, trailers and tents. Gravel sites, some highway truck noise. Mixed-use: many monthly residents alongside overnight travelers. CAMPER-REPORTED RATE: $57 a night in January 2026 and $60-65 in June-August 2026 (RV Life reviews); the park has no web page of its own (rvandhorses.com is a parked domain, 2026-10-27). --Claude
